news.notes: The Blackhawks did not practice before traveling to Calgary on Friday. ... Bedard, a center, will miss at least four games after being injured during a face-off during a 6-3 win against the Toronto Maple Leafs on Tuesday. ... Coach Jeff Blashill juggled his lines during a 4-2 loss to the Columbus Blue Jackets on Thursday and could make more changes prior to game time. ... Greenway, a healthy scratch the past three games, could enter the lineup in place of Boucher, a forward, and Korchinski could play in place of Del Mastro, a defenseman, after sitting out the past four games. … Commesso, called up from Rockford of the American Hockey League on Nov. 8, could make make his season debut against the Flames or at the Vancouver Canucks on Sunday. … Calgary held an optional practice Friday with only Backlund, Pospisil and Middleton not skating. … Coach Ryan Huska said he doesn’t anticipate making any lineup changes following a 4-1 loss to the Minnesota Wild on Thursday. ... Wolf is expected to make his third straight start after making 17 saves against the Wild.
